name: Cutout
tagline: Random square pixel mask zeroed out on the tensor after standard crop+flip; encourages broader spatial context use.
pseudocode:
1. RandomCrop(img_size, padding=4); RandomHorizontalFlip
2. ToTensor; Normalize prep
3. Sample center $(y, x) \sim \text{Uniform}(H) \times \text{Uniform}(W)$
4. Set patch $[y-L/2, y+L/2] \times [x-L/2, x+L/2]$ to zero
5. Normalize with channel mean/std
diff_from_baseline: DeVries & Taylor 2017 ('Improved Regularization of CNNs with Cutout'). Standard regularization baseline on small-image classification.

name: RandAugment
tagline: Randomly selects N=2 augmentation ops at fixed magnitude M=9 from a curated bank, applied before the geometric transforms.
pseudocode:
1. For each image, sample $n = 2$ ops uniformly from the RandAugment bank
2. Apply each op with magnitude $M = 9$ (fixed)
3. RandomCrop(img_size, padding=4)
4. RandomHorizontalFlip
5. ToTensor + Normalize
diff_from_baseline: Cubuk et al., CVPR 2020. Reduced search-space alternative to AutoAugment; (N, M) is the only tuning knob.

name: TrivialAugmentWide
tagline: Single random op with random magnitude per image from a wide bank; tuning-free strong augmentation.
pseudocode:
1. For each image, sample 1 op uniformly from the wide TrivialAugment bank
2. Sample its magnitude $m \sim \mathrm{Uniform}\{0, \dots, 30\}$
3. Apply the chosen op
4. RandomCrop(img_size, padding=4); RandomHorizontalFlip
5. ToTensor + Normalize
diff_from_baseline: Mueller & Hutter, ICCV 2021. Hyperparameter-free policy that often matches RandAugment / AutoAugment on standard image classification.
